name: Arcadion
about: Arcadion (class 1081), the daemon Sorcerer of the Obsidian Fortress who serves Malchir; free talk from the second meeting (G[232:1]) until the four symbols are returned (G[144:1]). INT-gated topic (PLAN-LEVELING.md 5; game/npc_dialog.h 'avatar_int'): shown only when the Avatar's INT is at least the number, behind New Dialogue.

topics.label: Why would the one unbound daemon study the art that binds daemons?
say: A curious sort, aren't you? Most who stand in this room ask how to leave it.
Consider, mortal: every daemon you will ever meet is held by a name it did not choose. I am the only one who is not. Do you suppose that is an accident?
One learns the lock best by studying it from the inside. And one keeps one's freedom by knowing exactly how others would take it away.
Master Malchir believes he is teaching me. Let him. One does not live very long when one has displeased a Master Sorcerer. Nor, I think, when one has stopped learning.
